en: Vintage sepia postcard depicting a classical colonnaded terrace with several statues of draped female figures (Muses) in front of a building richly decorated with murals. The architecture is neoclassical, with tall columns and a partially visible interior. Greek and French captions are printed beneath the image, and there is additional Greek text along the right margin. A website watermark (www.elia.org.gr) appears over the image.
